slides.headline: What does it mean?
slides.body: A competitor's closure can present a genuine opportunity to acquire equipment, stock or even market share at a good price — but it's worth evaluating on its own merits, not just the appeal of a bargain. Equipment finance can fund a considered purchase without a large cash outlay.

caption:
A competitor's closure can be a genuine opportunity, but the appeal of a low price shouldn't override a clear-eyed evaluation of whether the assets actually fit your business.

Once that evaluation supports the purchase, equipment finance can move quickly enough to capture the opportunity without committing all your cash to it.
